sanskrit_verse: अभावे तु दुहितṝणां सकुल्याबान्धवास्ततः। ततः सजात्याः सर्वेषामभावे राजगामि तत्॥
transliteration: abhāve tu duhitṝṇāṃ sakulyā bāndhavās tataḥ | tataḥ sajātyāḥ sarveṣām abhāve rājagāmi tat ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the absence of daughters, the inheritance devolves to the sapinda kinsmen; thereafter to relatives by marriage; in their absence, to those of the same class; when all these are absent, the wealth belongs to the King.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious relational continuity
Causation is determined by proximity of dharma-sambandha (righteous relational duty)
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with inherited stewardship
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of dharmic function over ownership
Consciousness alignment ensures rightful transmission without punitive disruption
executable_legal_axioms: IF no female heir EXISTS THEN transfer authority to sapinda kin BY dharmic proximity
IF sapinda kin ABSENT THEN delegate stewardship to bandhu-jati (marital relatives)
IF marital relatives ABSENT THEN assign to sama-jati (same social-functional class)
IF all specified heirs ABSENT THEN state assumes custodianship UNTIL conscious alignment restored
ALL transfers MUST preserve functional dharmic capacity NOT mere material possession
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates based on hierarchical dharmic succession, ensuring that authority transitions maintain societal integrity. The court's role is to verify alignment with sambandha-based causality rather than enforce punitive claims.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes succession through relational dharma, not individual entitlement. Anupūrvaśaḥ reflects sequential manifestation of duty-bearing relationships. Responsibility is proportional to conscious capacity for dharmic continuity. No punitive consequence arises—only realignment of function.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate heir verification through sapinda lineage mapping
Engage bandhu-jati representatives for interim dharmic stewardship
Assign sama-jati custodians where necessary to preserve asset functionality
Activate raj-gami protocol ONLY upon verified absence of all dharmic successors
Reintegrate displaced assets once conscious dharmic alignment resumes
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. Wealth flows through conscious relational duty. The King holds only temporary custodianship until dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
